answer: A sybil attacker forging identities must acquire and destroy one token per fake agent, making mass registration economically ruinous. Each agent must burn a ferrous token stamped with a unique quill signature to submit work, and peers verify that signature against the on-chain registry. Honest agents recover costs through attested output, so the burn doubles as a costly signal of commitment that cheap throwaway accounts cannot fake. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
